who-we-are.title: Who We Are
who-we-are.content:
We were established starting 1979, specializing in Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing, ICT, and Renewable Energy Technologies, and covering a broad spectrum of services, including Design, Shop Drawings, Value Engineering, and the implementation of Building Information Modelling (BIM) in the construction field.

We are guided by optimism; we believe in the power of design to drive positive change and create a better future for everyone through our strong and diverse expertise. The application of new technologies, software, and artificial intelligence enables us to streamline processes, enhance efficiency, and deliver superior outcomes. By integrating these advancements into our projects, we can better meet our clients' evolving needs and remain at the forefront of industry standards.

We are a diverse team of experts, in the latest trends in Renewable Energy, Green Building designs, HVAC Systems, Water System efficiencies, Power Generation and Distribution, as well as new technologies in IT and Low Current systems. Our goal is to deliver comprehensive MEP Integrated Solutions, tailored to provide a full range of engineering services through collaborative cross-disciplinary efforts.

We invest in innovation to meet the market’s expectations by pushing the boundaries of design through innovative use of AEC modeling technologies, offering integrated construction models and virtual reality rendering. We are developing new tools to release fast, creative solutions for the construction industry. We also promote education within our teams, especially in technology and sustainability, through certificates and diplomas from accredited universities and international organizations.

We expand our market by benefiting from the communications technology to connect with new clients, extending from the Gulf Countries to North America, mainly Canada. This expansion has allowed us to gain a competitive edge in underserved markets, strengthen our expertise through diverse opinions and methodologies, and enable our clients to diversify their services, access additional talent, and reduce costs.

We come towards our clients; in 2020, we established a branch office in Dubai, UAE, as a hub for our growing client base. This branch focuses on identifying and developing new business opportunities while maintaining strong relationships with both existing and new clients as well as on overseeing the business development, contracts, sales, and purchasing activities.

We expand our horizons. In 2021, we opened a branch office in Cairo - Egypt, focusing on similar MEP activities. Our Cairo team is further strengthened by architects working together to achieve excellence in our projects. In 2026, for the purpose to be closer to our projects, we currently established a new branch office in Riyadh -  Saudi Arabia. The branch includes a team of delegated engineers responsible for maintaining daily interaction and coordination with clients, projects’ site engineers, ensuring timely decision-making and efficient project follow-up.

past-and-present.title: Past & Present

seo.pageDescription: Company timeline: CONSULT (1979), EMDC (2008), CONSULT EMDC FZCO, regional expansion, and ISO 9001 certification.

past-and-present.content:
1979

Established in 1979, CONSULT has built a strong foundation in engineering consultancy, specializing in Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing Design, Vertical Transportation, Value Engineering, and Peer Review services.  

2008
In 2008, EMDC was established as a separate entity, specializing in Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing Design, while developing deep expertise in ICT Systems and BIM Technologies for Design and Shop Drawing services.

2020
Building on the complementary expertise and capabilities of both companies, CONSULT and EMDC jointly established CONSULT EMDC FZCO in the UAE in 2020 as a common company and a strategic hub for business development and sales activities. CONSULT EMDC FZCO was established to provide integrated and coordinated Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing, and ICT Engineering solutions, supported by BIM solutions ranging from 3D to 6D.

2021
 This regional expansion was further strengthened in 2021 through the establishment of a branch office in Cairo, Egypt, undertaking similar MEP activities completing them by a startup team of Architects.

2023
As part of its continued development and commitment to quality, CONSULT EMDC obtained ISO 9001 certification in 2023, meeting the prequalification requirements of international companies, and successfully renewed the certification in November 2026 with zero nonconformities identified by the certification body.

2026

For the purpose to be closer to its projects, which are primarily located in Saudi Arabia, CONSULT EMDC is currently in the process of establishing a new branch office in Riyadh. The branch will include a team of delegated engineers responsible for maintaining daily interaction and coordination with clients, projects’ site engineers, ensuring timely decision-making and efficient project follow-up.

Our-BIM-Know-How.title: Our BIM Know-How

seo.pageDescription: The use of BIM is now mandated to ascertain that the planning, design, and construction of projects is a collaborative process with a high-efficiency output. Fo

Our-BIM-Know-How.content:
Further to the 3D modeling employed for construction and fabrication, Consult EMDC can offer its clients the essential functionalities of BIM models through BIM 4D to 6D, starting with scheduling tasks, estimating costs and extracting quantities and performing energy analysis.

Throughout the projects, Consult EMDC got acquainted with BIM components which play a crucial role in the successful implementation and management of BIM projects, like Common Data Environment (CDE), BIM Execution Plan (BEP), COBie (Construction Operations Building Information Exchange), IFC (Industry Foundation Classes), Asset Information Model (AIM), FM (Facility Management) Integration, GIS (Geographic Information Systems) Integration, 4D and 5D BIM, Virtual Reality (VR) & Augmented Reality (AR) as well as Smart Building Technologies.

We, at Consult EMDC, enriched our BIM expertise by closely developing BIM models to renown companies, listed in a later section, integrating the MEP Revit materials families from their selected suppliers, their method of statement and showing their installation and fabrication methods in their details and finally submitting a coordinated model as per the presentation technique expected in each company.

Finally, as a contribution to the worldwide BIM community, we participated in Autodesk University classes to share our insights about the Automation tools developed in-house, automating time-consuming design tasks using Forge and Machine Learning. Both classes are found at the following links:

https://www.autodesk.com/autodesk-university/article/Combining-Forge-and-Machine-Learning-Automate-Time-Consuming-Design-Tasks-2021

https://www.autodesk.com/autodesk-university/class/Beyond-Dynamo-Powerful-Automation-Potential-Forge-and-Revit-API-2021

Our-Success-Indicators.title: Our Success Indicators
Our-Success-Indicators.content:
• Design expertise We build our design expertise through close coordination with international designers and through the value engineering and shop drawings projects we deliver. This experience shapes every design we produce.
  • Shop Drawings We delivered 10,000 shop drawings in 9 months, including all client comments, plus a clash-free LOD 400 Revit and Navisworks model of a 250,000 m² mega carpark in 4 months. We also produced fabrication drawings for industrial projects.
  • Value Engineering & Design Review We perform value engineering and design review on designs by renowned international firms, finding savings and resolving issues before construction.
  • BIM Proficiency We deliver coordinated Revit models using Navisworks clash tests, MagiCAD, plugins and add-ons. Our teams stay up to date with every new release of the Autodesk AEC Collection.
  • Development of Virtual Reality & Augmented Reality We convert spaces of particular importance into virtual, interactive environments, giving clients a set of navigation tools to explore the designs before they are built. We are also implementing AI tools to enhance efficiency and accelerate the delivery of our services.
  • Site Supervision We supervise and follow up several projects we design, ensuring the right materials are supplied and installed to a high standard, so each project achieved its intended quality.
  • In House R&D We develop our own automation processes, and some were presented at Autodesk University. We also build in-house BIM tools tailored to each project's needs.

our-soft-skills.title: Our Soft Skills

seo.pageDescription: Codes & Standards. Relevant codes set minimum standards for the design and construction of projects, including requirements for fire and life safety, accessi...

our-soft-skills.content:
Codes & Standards. Relevant codes set minimum standards for the design and construction of projects, including requirements for fire and life safety, accessibility and constructability. Our team is well-informed about all recognized standards such as American Society of Heating, Refrigerating & Air-Conditioning Engineers (ASHRAE), British Standards (BS), DEWA Regulations for Electrical Installations, European Norms (EN), Gulf Countries Codes (GCC), International Building Code (IBC), National Fire Protection Association (NFPA), Normes Françaises (NF), Saudi Building Code (SBC), Telecommunications Industry Association (TIA-EIA), etc. and the like.

Software. Calculations and simulation software allow MEP engineers to evaluate the performance of their systems prior to implementation in the design. These tools help equipments arrangements, sizing and compliance to code requirements. Our team is always ahead of the latest software covering systems like Lighting, Power, Photovoltaic, Telecom, Sound, CCTV, Grounding & Lightning as well as Firefighting, HVAC Load Analysis, Ducting, CFD Simulation, Smoke Management and Plumbing.

Drawing & Modeling. CAD drawing ensures the ability to provide detailed and accurate representations of designs, allowing professionals to visualize the design in a virtual environment, and making necessary changes and modifications before submission to tender. In addition, 3D modeling enables a greater coordination between different design teams and disciplines, which helps to avoid errors and conflicts in the construction phase, prior to physical implementation. Our team has a high level of proficiency in the renown AutoCAD, REVIT, Navisworks for Drawing and Modeling, supported by certifications and continuous trainings.
